svg.aria-label: About Shuvodip: Frontend Engineer at Dharma Angels, building MeditationTTC, a 12-week live online meditation teacher training; Frontend Engineer Intern at SpeakGenie, and Lead Frontend Engineer for our team at the Google AI Hackathon; AWS Business Intelligence Engineer Nanodegree, AWS AI & ML scholar at Udacity, Responsive Web Design by freeCodeCamp; Backend engineering, AI systems, and STEM & CS foundations; Udacity’s Autonomous Systems School, with a pull toward robotics, self-driving cars, and autonomous flight; Open-source collaboration, real-world tech ideas, and chats about AI, robotics & innovation
